Messages.Body:
Enkidu's gametext says "He cannot have or use equipment" but doesn't
actually prohibit him from performing equip actions.
so i was wondering and hoping to get a clarification for the following
questions:
1.) can he still equip and use loquipment cards like Palatial Estate? (i
think so)

2.) if he's still allowed to perform equip actions even though he can't use
or have this equipment, what happens to it? (i guess it's just burned...)

regards,
Mat

Yes, since having that location is not prohibited.

> 2.) if he's still allowed to perform equip actions even though he can't use
> or have this equipment, what happens to it? (i guess it's just burned...)

He cannot equip with something he is prohibited from having.

As far as I know, a minion with "[insert name here] cannot have
equipment" text cannot even try to equip. He/she cannot even have
equipment transferred to him/her with Heidelberg Castle or Nod. He/she
cannot receive the Rowan Ring after being hit with it (the strike is
applied and the equipment simply burns). He cannot be Shackled :-)
